governing_document: Rajasthan Unified Building Bylaws & Rajasthan Energy Conservation Building Code (RECBC)
authority: Urban Development & Housing Department, Govt of Rajasthan
climate_adaptations: Hot & Dry climate zone adaptations requiring high thermal mass envelope and restricted fenestration on west/south-west facades.
Mandatory solar water heating and rainwater harvesting for plot areas > 300 m².
Mandatory deep overhangs / Jharokhas for microclimate buffering.

rules.clause: RECBC Clause 4.3 - West Facing Glazing Ratio
rules.description: Glazed openings on West and South-West exposed facades must not exceed 15% to mitigate extreme evening peak solar heat gains.
rules.remediation: Re-orient fenestration to North/East or install external vertical louvers.

rules.clause: Byelaw 14.3 - Thermal Mass Requirement in Arid Zones
rules.description: Exterior walls in arid regions must possess volumetric heat capacity >= 160 kJ/m²K (e.g. 200mm CSEB, fly-ash brick, or stone masonry) for thermal phase lag.
rules.remediation: Increase wall thickness or replace lightweight panels with dense earth block or brick masonry.
